  "title": "Brand Manager",
  "description": "Promasidor - We are an African company proud of our heritage and totally committed to the continent. We manufacture, market and sell unique brands which bring practicality and pleasure to millions of consumers across Africa.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Brand Manager

Job Location: Oshodi - Isolo, Lagos
Job Type: Full-time

About the Job


	The Brand Manager translates category strategy and growth bets into strong, consumer-led brand plans and disciplined execution for assigned brand(s).
	The role builds stronger, more relevant brands that drive profitable category growth by combining consumer insight, brand planning, demand creation, innovation and commercial performance.
	Working through the Category Growth Squad and with shared Marketing capabilities, the Brand Manager is the day-to-day custodian of the assigned brand(s), converting strategy into clear plans, 90-day priorities, high-quality execution and performance learning.


Responsibilities


	Convert category strategy and growth bets into annual brand plans, 90-day priorities and clear execution roadmaps for assigned brand(s).
	Define brand objectives, strategic choices, activity calendars and success measures aligned with category and business goals.
	Use consumer, competitor, channel and brand performance data to identify growth opportunities, risks and actions.
	Recommend portfolio, SKU, pack, pricing and activation actions that strengthen brand power and profitable category growth.
	Act as day-to-day brand custodian, protecting positioning, identity and consistency across teams, agencies and consumer touchpoints.
	Build deep understanding of target consumers, shoppers, category trends and competitive activity using research, market intelligence and field learning.
	Translate insight into clear opportunity spaces, brand propositions, communication ideas and innovation concepts for review with the Category Manager.
	Support concept, claims, pack, pricing and business-case development, ensuring ideas are consumer relevant, distinctive and commercially viable.
	Execute approved brand positioning, identity, tone of voice and consumer promise consistently across assigned touchpoints.
	Develop integrated demand-creation plans across media, digital, social, PR, experiential, trade and in-market activation as relevant.
	Write sharp, consumer-grounded agency briefs that connect brand strategy, business objectives, target audience, desired response and KPIs.
	Partner with Media &amp; Connections and agency teams to improve creative quality, media effectiveness and execution consistency.
	Track campaign impact and optimize activity based on evidence, learning and return on investment.
	Maintain high standards of brand expression across packaging, content, POS and consumer activation.
	Play an active role in the Category Growth Squad, owning agreed brand actions and helping unblock delivery.
	Partner with Insights, Media, Operations, sales, Trade Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain and R&amp;D to convert plans into coordinated execution.
	Bring clear brand performance updates, business cases and recommendations to weekly and monthly reviews.
	Manage agencies and external partners against agreed scope, timing, quality, budget and performance expectations.
	Support junior team members where applicable and contribute to a collaborative, accountable and learning-oriented Promasidor culture.


Qualifications


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Commerce or a related field.
	2 to 5 years of relevant experience in FMCG, consumer goods or a similar fast-paced marketing environment, with hands-on exposure to brand management, communication, innovation and commercial execution.
	Professional marketing qualification / membership of CIM or equivalent is an added advantage.
	Demonstrated ability to manage projects cross-functionally, work with agencies and turn consumer / market insights into effective brand actions.
	Experience in food, beverage or consumer packaged goods is an added advantage.


Knowledge &amp; Technical Skills:


	Strong working knowledge of MS Office, Excel and presentation tools.
	Good understanding of brand strategy, consumer and shopper insight, integrated marketing communications, digital / social and media fundamentals.
	Working knowledge of brand scorecards, marketing effectiveness, budgets, basic P&amp;L concepts, pricing and commercial performance measures.
	Familiarity with innovation / NPD, proposition development, portfolio management, route-to-market and structured post-launch learning.

Logistics Officer Job at Myrtle Management Consultants




        
    

        
        Myrtle Management Consultants RC1083018 is proudly an indigenous African company set up with the objective to be the preferred and reliable partner in core business management processes. As part of our key focus, we aim to support our clients to achieve a synergy between people, system and processes. Incorporated in 2012, Myrtle is a fast-growing firm, with a dynamic, insightful and professional leadership team.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Logistics Officer

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

            
    




	To coordinate the efficient movement of personnel, equipment, materials, and supplies to support Oil & Gas operations, projects, and offshore/onshore activities.


Key Responsibilities


	Coordinate transportation and movement of personnel, equipment, materials, and supplies.
	Plan and monitor logistics activities for operational and project requirements.
	Coordinate crew movements, mobilization, demobilization, and travel arrangements.
	Liaise with transporters, vendors, marine operators, freight forwarders, and other logistics providers.
	Coordinate delivery, receipt, storage, and dispatch of materials and equipment.
	Track shipments and ensure timely delivery to operational locations.
	Prepare logistics schedules, movement plans, and supporting documentation.
	Maintain accurate records of vehicles, equipment movements, deliveries, and logistics activities.
	Monitor logistics costs and support cost-control initiatives.
	Ensure compliance with company HSE, security, and logistics procedures.
	Resolve transportation, delivery, documentation, and scheduling issues.
	Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly logistics reports.
	Support offshore/onshore mobilization and project logistics as required.


Qualifications


	B.Sc ./ HND in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Transport Management, Business Administration, or related field.
	5–7 years of relevant logistics experience within the Oil & Gas industry.
	Experience supporting offshore/onshore operations is highly desirable.
	Knowledge of Nigerian Oil & Gas logistics and regulatory requirements.
	Proficiency in MS Office and logistics/ERP systems.


Core Competencies:


	Logistics & Transportation Management
	Supply Chain Coordination
	Crew Mobilization
	Vendor Management
	Inventory & Materials Handling
	Planning & Coordination
	Cost Control
	Documentation & Reporting
	HSE Awareness
	Problem-Solving & Communication.


Benefit
The remuneration package is competitive, along with other benefits.

Note


	Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis up to the closing date.
	Successful candidates will be required to undergo additional assessments as part of the selection process.
